unde.mean: from where, whence; from which, hence
notes: Interrogative and relative: unde es tū? ‘where are you from?’
Genitive ūnīus, dative ūnī in all genders.
ūnus ex ‘one of’; also an indefinite ‘a, a certain’ in the Vulgate.
Both parts decline: ūnīuscujusque, ūnīcuique, ūnumquemque.
